Sandbox_PortableCharacters_AllowTransfer: Players can pick a character they played somewhere else. It arrives with its skills, traits, known recipes and injuries (a bite stays a bite). Off: everyone here starts with a new character (which is still saved, and can be taken elsewhere).
Sandbox_PortableCharacters_TransferInven: A character from another world arrives with what it was carrying and wearing (keys always stay in their own world). Off: it arrives with the usual starting things only.
Sandbox_PortableCharacters_AllowRevive_t: Players can pick a character from their Dead tab and play it again. It comes back healthy, with its skills and traits, without its things (those stayed on the body). Needs "Allow characters from other worlds".
